title: Film Junk Podcast Episode #1037: Gimme Shelter (1970)
description: Who's fighting and what for? Why are we fighting? Is there a difference between direct cinema and cinema verité? Is Mick Jagger's stage banter "cringe"? Should all live musical performances sound just like the original album recording? Who is better... The Beatles or The Rolling Stones? Get yer ya-ya's out on this week's episode of Film Junk.

description:
Join us on episode 102 of the Film Junk Premium Podcast as we discuss the films of Werner Herzog. We hand-picked a selection of movies that capture his unusual blend of fact and fiction, some of which are the catalyst of the unbelievable myths and legends connected to the filmmaker Muhammad Ali once called "One of the most significant voices in German cinema."

Upon discovering a smudge on one of the signatures, Werner Herzog himself called in to comment on the situation. Now, a decade later, the purchases have finally paid off. Please enjoy against your better judgment.
